home.footer: Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si gɔme woɖe fifia & li le gbegbɔgblɔ 100+ me!
home.descriptionA: Senior full-stack engineer si si ƒe 6+ ƒe nuteƒekpɔkpɔ le tsɔa adzɔnuwo tso nudidi siwo me mekɔ o me yia nuwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo siwo ŋu kakaɖedzi le gbɔ. Mewɔa xɔtuɖaŋu si le megbe na React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C #, Go, kple SQL dɔwɔɖoɖowo: subɔsubɔ ƒe liƒo siwo me kɔ, nyatakaka ƒe kpɔɖeŋu siwo nɔa anyi didi, mɔɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo siwo le dedie, kple mɔ siwo dzi woatsɔ nuawo ayi na amewo ƒe ƒuƒoƒowo ate ŋu awɔ dɔ kple kakaɖedzi.
home.descriptionB: Nye dɔa doa ƒome kple mɔ̃ɖaŋu ŋuti nyametsotsowo kple asitsatsa me tsonu. Tso SaaS si bua xɔtutu ŋu si trɔa spreadsheet data wozua aɖaŋuɖoɖo siwo sɔ na asisiwo dzi va ɖo nyatakakadzraɖoƒe siwo naa gakpɔkpɔ dzi la, metua kɔmpiutadziɖoɖowo ƒoa xlã dɔwɔwɔ, afɔku, kple... asixɔxɔ si woate ŋu adzidze si le vevie na ame siwo zãnɛ.

personal_summary.title: Ame ŋutɔ ƒe Nyatakaka Kpuie
personal_summary.text: Nyee nye mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔla tsitsi aɖe si nye full-stack si le Orlando, FL si tɔe nye mɔ si tso adzɔnuwo ƒe kuxi me yi ewɔwɔ me tsonu dzi. Mewɔa mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe tiatia le ɖoɖoa ƒe subɔsubɔdɔ me: .NET kple Entity Framework Core ne domenyinyi si woɖo sesĩe kple kutrikuku si woate ŋu ado kpɔ le vevie; Angular alo React ne nu sesẽ dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo hiã na ŋgɔdonya si woate ŋu alé be na; Node.js alo Yi ne API, ƒoƒo ɖekae, alo dɔwɔnu si wɔa dɔ nyuie hiã na dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi si ŋu woƒe susu le. Le SaaS ƒe adzɔnuwo, dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo ememetɔwo, kple asisiwo ƒe mɔnu siwo dze ŋgɔe me la, mexɔa ŋgɔ kple asitsatsa siwo dze ƒã, aɖaŋuwɔwɔ si le dedie eye wòte ŋu nɔa te ɖe nɔnɔme sesẽwo nu, dodokpɔ siwo wowɔna le wo ɖokui si, kple nuwo ɖoɖoɖa ƒe nuwɔna siwo... kpena ɖe ƒuƒoƒowo ŋu be woaɖo kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo xɔasiwo ɖe wo evɔ womagblẽ fe si wodo le dɔwɔwɔ me ɖi o.

entries.jobtitle: Kɔmpiutadziɖoɖowo Ŋuti Mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔla Kplɔla (Sukuviwo ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi) .

entries.title: Blibo Stack Mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔwɔ
entries.text: Mexɔa ŋgɔ na adzɔnuwo tsɔtsɔ yi nuwuwu: asitsatsa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖowo gɔmeɖeɖe ɖe ɖoɖoa ƒe liƒowo, nyatakakawo ƒe kpɔɖeŋuwo, APIwo, kple ŋgɔdonyawo me, emegbe dɔa tsɔtsɔ to dodokpɔ, dɔwɔwɔ, . kple gbugbɔgagblɔ. Taɖodzinuae nye kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo si ƒuƒoƒo aɖe ate ŋu atrɔ asi le ahazã, ke menye screen siwo me kadodo mele o ƒe ƒuƒoƒo o.

entries.title: Product & Platform Xɔtuɖaŋu
entries.text: Metiaa mɔ̃wo kple kpɔɖeŋuwo ɖe kuxia dzi: .NET dɔwɔna siwo wotsɔ ƒuƒoƒo wɔe na asitsaƒe ƒe domenyinyiwo, Angular alo React dɔwɔɖoɖo siwo wotsɔa akpa aɖewo kplɔna na dɔwɔwɔ sesẽwo, ƒomedodo nyatakakawo ƒe kpɔɖeŋuwo na dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo siwo ŋu woabu akɔnta le, kple ƒoƒo ɖekae siwo wowɔ kple kpododonu ƒe mɔnuwo, mɔɖeɖe ɖe nu ŋu dzi kpɔkpɔ, kple beléle na wo le susu me.

entries.title: Production-Ready Delivery si le dzadzraɖoɖi
entries.text: Metuae kple nu ŋutɔŋutɔ siwo le dodo ɖe ŋgɔ megbe le susu me: nya ɣaɣla siwo wodzra ɖo le dzɔtsoƒedzikpɔkpɔ me, nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe ʋuʋu ƒe mɔ siwo me kɔ, mɔɖeɖe si wotu ɖe akpa dzi, kpeɖodzinana le ɖoɖoa ƒe liƒowo dzi, . dodokpɔ siwo wowɔna le wo ɖokui si, CI/CD ŋuti sidzedze, kple ŋkuléle ɖe nu ŋu ŋutɔŋutɔ. Esiawoe nye nyatakaka tsitotsito siwo trɔa kpɔɖeŋu aɖe wòzua kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo si dzi woate ŋu aka ɖo.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON ƒe agbalẽ
biblioteca.text: Python-dzi localization pipeline si trɔa nyatakakatsoƒe ɖeka si woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu wòzua xexeame katã ƒe portfolio si ŋu woate ŋu aɖo. Ekpɔa gbegɔmeɖeɖe ŋuti nyatakakawo gbɔ abe ɖoɖo si ŋu woate ŋu alé be na ene tsɔ wu be wòatsɔ asi awɔ axa ƒe kɔpi si wogbugbɔ wɔ, si wɔnɛ be nyatakakadzraɖoƒea te ŋu dzidzea gbegbɔgblɔ 100+ eye wònana xexeame katã ƒe asiɖoɖoanyi an dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ŋutete le esi teƒe be wòanye nusi wowɔna zi ɖeka.

connect_four.title: Do ka kple Ene
connect_four.text: Massive ƒome si wu 50+ implementations le Connect Ene fefea. Dɔ sia ƒe akpa aɖewoe nye dɔwɔwɔ le ɖoɖowɔɖigbe vovovo siwo wu 30 me, siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, kple bubuwo. Tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, egadea ɖoɖowɔɖi vovovo siwo wu 20+ alo nɔnɔme bubuwo hã ɖe eme, siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye React.js, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET, kple bubuwo.

grocery_app.title: Nuɖuɖudzraƒe ƒe App
grocery_app.text: .NET 9 Blazor Server dɔwɔɖoɖo si le ƒuƒoƒo blibo me si ɖea megbenyawo ƒe xɔtuɖoɖo si woɖo koŋ fiana na asitsatsa ƒe dɔwɔwɔ. Dzɔla/subɔsubɔ/nudzraɖoƒe ƒe mama na be dɔwɔwɔ ƒe sewo, nyatakakawo ƒe yiyi, kple nuɖeɖefia woate ŋu ado le wo ɖokui si; Entity Framework Core naa kutrikuku si nɔa anyi didina; kple... dodokpɔ ƒe ɖoɖo si me kɔ nyuie kpɔa nuwɔna ta ne nusi wowɔ la le tɔtrɔm.

interop.title: Interop Dɔwɔɖoɖo
interop.text: Gbegbɔgblɔ vovovowo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ aduadu ƒe nufiame si xɔ ɖoɖowɔɖigbe 15 kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo 18. Dɔa kua liƒo si me ɖoɖowo va zua nusiwo me gblẽna le zi geɖe: dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nubablawo, nyatakakawo ɖɔliɖɔli, dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nuwɔna, kple ƒoƒo ɖekae ƒe mɔ siwo woate ŋu agbugbɔ awɔ. Eɖea ɖoɖowo ƒe tamebubu si hiã ne nusi wowɔ lolo wu ƒuƒoƒo ɖeka fiana.

inventory_register.title: Nudzraɖoƒewo ƒe Ŋkɔgbalẽ
inventory_register.text: POS blibo kple nudzraɖoƒe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si wotu kple Angular 17+ kple Node.js. Ewɔa kpɔɖeŋu na B2B ɖoɖo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ŋuti dzimaɖitsitsiwo: ezãla siwo ŋu woɖo kpee, akpa si wowɔna dzi kpɔkpɔ le mɔɖeɖe ɖe nu ŋu dzi, nudzraɖoƒewo ƒe nyateƒetoto, kple fexexe ƒe sisi si wowɔna abe fefe ene. Wotrɔ asi le dɔa ŋu ƒo xlã dɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ si agbalẽŋlɔlawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo aɖe wɔna, ke menye ɖoɖowɔɖia ƒe nɔnɔmewo ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo ɖeɖeko o.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL nyaa si
payrollobol.text: A local payroll processing system si wotu kple GnuCOBOL, SQLite double-entry ledger, kple Svelte operations dashboard. Ezãa akɔntabubu si me numekɔkɔwo le, ga home ŋuti dɔ wɔwɔ, kple loopback dashboard tsɔ wɔa ganyawo ƒe dɔwo ŋu dɔ nyuie, woate ŋu akpɔ wo adze sii, eye woawɔ dɔ nyuie.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Auto ƒe Nɔnɔmewɔwɔ
formatter.text: JSON kple YAML ƒe kpeɖodzinana kple ɖoɖowɔwɔ dɔwɔnu si wotu ɖe browser dzi si wotu ɖe Go me eye woƒoe nu ƒu ɖe WebAssembly me. Ne èʋu parsing engine la yi WASM me la, enaa kadodoa nɔa ŋu ɖom eye wònɔa teƒe ɖeka na browser la esime nèle parser ŋutɔŋutɔ zãm be yealé nya siwo mesɔ o. Enye kpɔɖeŋu si ŋu wotsi dzi ɖo le tiatiawɔɣi ƒe xɔtuɖaŋu na dɔwɔwɔ, tsɔtsɔ yi teƒe bubu, kple zãla ƒe kakaɖedzi.

takeoff_engine.title: Yameʋuɖoɖo ƒe Mɔ̃
takeoff_engine.text: Xɔtutu si bu SaaS ŋu si wotu ƒo xlã kontraktɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ si xɔa ga geɖe, si me vodadawo bɔ ɖo. React + Express ƒe nuwɔna la xɔa CSV kple Excel ƒe nyatakakawo, ewɔa sɔti siwo mewɔ ɖeka o ƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖe domenyinyi ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si woate ŋu azã me, bua akɔnta le dowo kuku kple anyigbadɔwɔwɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme ŋu, ekplɔa dɔwɔlawo ɖo eye... markup, eye wòwɔa PDF kple Word ƒe aɖaŋuɖoɖo siwo sɔ na asisiwo. Esia nye adzɔnuwo ƒe agbenɔƒe ƒe mɔ̃ɖaŋu blibo: nyatakakawo me toto, akɔntabubu ƒe sewo, dɔwɔla ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo si wowɔ nyuie, kple nusiwo woatsɔ aɖo ɖa siwo kpena ɖe asitsaha aɖe ŋu wòʋuna tso nusiwo wotsɔ de eme xoxo dzi yia asidada dzi.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Dɔwɔƒe si wɔa dɔ
minecraft_json_generator.text: JSON generator si le bɔbɔe si wotu le Python me na Minecraft resource & data packs. Wozãa dɔ sia tsɔ wɔa JSON faɛlwo na Minecraft mods, siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye nusiwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu, blocks, kple entities. Viɖe le eŋu ŋutɔ na menye datapacks tɔxɛwo wɔwɔ ko o, ke boŋ na mods hã to mod ŋkɔ tɔtrɔ ƒe nɔnɔme dzi.

educational_experience.title: Nye Sukudede Ŋuti Nuteƒekpɔkpɔ
educational_experience.text: Tsɔ kpe ɖe nye ŋutɔ nye dɔwo ŋu la, aɖaŋu gbogbo aɖewo hã su asinye tso sukudede ŋuti nuteƒekpɔkpɔwo me. Zi afisia dzi be nàkpɔ nye LinkedIn nyatakakawo hena nyatakaka bubuwo.

professional_experience.title: Nye Dɔwɔwɔ Ŋuti Nuteƒekpɔkpɔ
professional_experience.text: Ƒe ade kple edzivɔ ƒe mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔwɔ ŋuti nuteƒekpɔkpɔ le adzɔnuwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒowo, asitsahabɔbɔwo, kple kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo siwo dze ŋgɔ asisiwo me. Nye dɔa dometɔ aɖewoe nye dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ƒuƒoƒo siwo ŋu woate ŋu alé be na tutu, nuwɔwɔ aduadu le nudɔdɔ ƒe nusɔsrɔ̃wo katã me, kple mɔ̃ɖaŋu ŋuti nyametsotsowo wɔwɔ kple adzɔnuwo ƒe agbenɔƒe, dɔwɔwɔ afɔku, kple ɣeyiɣi didi ƒe aƒetɔ nyenye le susu me.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin ƒe Dɔwɔƒe ƒe Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe
portfolio_website.text: React ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si ƒe susu le nuwɔwɔ ŋu si bua alesi woate ŋu akpɔe kple xexeame katã ƒe asiɖoɖo anyi abe mɔ̃ɖaŋununya ƒe nudidiwo ene. Elɔ gbegɔmeɖeɖe ƒe mɔ̃ si woate ŋu alé be na na gbegbɔgblɔ 100+, dɔwɔnu siwo wɔa dɔ aduadu siwo WebAssembly da megbe na, UI ƒe nɔnɔme siwo wɔa dɔ eye woate ŋu akpɔ wo, kple dɔa ƒe xɔtuɖoɖo ɖe eme wowɔe be wòatsi ne wole dɔ yeyewo ɖom ɖe meli.

lua_library.title: Patrick ƒe Lua Nuŋɔŋlɔgbalẽdzraɖoƒe
lua_library.text: Lua ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si ŋu viɖe le be woazã le etsɔme. Wozãa agbalẽdzraɖoƒe sia tsɔ wɔa dɔwo le wo ɖokui si le Lua ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo me, si ateŋu ava ɖe vi na dɔ siwo hiã dɔwɔwɔ, elabena zi geɖe la, Lua nyea ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ si zɔna kabakaba wu Python kple Ruby siaa.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick ƒe Microsoft Excel ƒe Agbalẽvi ƒe Nuŋɔŋlɔwo (VBA) .
excel_scripts.text: VBA ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si ŋu viɖe le na Microsoft Excel. Wozãa agbalẽdzraɖoƒe sia tsɔ wɔa dɔ siwo le Excel ƒe agbalẽviwo me le wo ɖokui si.

neovim_config.title: Patrick ƒe Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Nye ŋutɔ nye Neovim ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ. Wozãa dɔ sia tsɔ ɖoa ​​Neovim ɖe nye didi nu, si me keybindings, tanyawo, kple plugins siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu hã le. Wozãa dɔ sia tsɔ naa Neovim zazã le bɔbɔe wu eye wòwɔa dɔ nyuie wu na nye ŋutɔ nye zazã.

python_maps.title: Patrick ƒe Anyigbatata Dɔwɔƒe
python_maps.text: Python anyigba ƒe teƒe ŋuti nyatakaka dɔwɔnu si wotu kple GeoPandas kple Matplotlib be woawɔ U.S. nuto kple dukɔa ƒe anyigbatatawo. Etrɔa anyigba ƒe nɔnɔme ŋuti nyatakakawo wozua numekuku ƒe asinudɔwɔwɔ siwo woate ŋu axlẽ, si ɖea nyatakakawo ƒe pɔmpi ƒe susu fiana: tia domenyiŋusẽfianu ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe siwo sɔ, na nusiwo wotsɔ de eme la nasɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu, eye nàwɔ emetsonu siwo do alɔ nyametsotso siwo me kɔ.

powershell_library.title: Patrick ƒe PowerShell Script Agbalẽdzraɖoƒe
powershell_library.text: PowerShell ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si ŋu viɖe le hena etsɔme zazã. Viɖe le $profile script ƒe nɔnɔme ŋu, mekpɔe be esia kpena ɖe ame ŋu ŋutɔ le dɔwo wɔwɔ le wo ɖokui si tso Windows ƒe nuwuƒe, elabena menye Windows OS zãla enuenu.

ruby_library.title: Patrick ƒe Ruby Script Agbalẽdzraɖoƒe
ruby_library.text: Ruby ŋɔŋlɔdzesiwo ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si ŋu viɖe le be woazã le etsɔme. Viɖe le eŋu na etsɔme Ruby on Rails ƒe ŋgɔyiyi ƒe susuwo.

pdf_builder.title: PDF Aɖaŋudɔwo Tula
pdf_builder.text: Nuŋlɔɖi-dzidzidɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo si wotu kple Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, kple JSON nyatakaka siwo woɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu. Ema nyatakaka siwo woate ŋu azã ake tso nuƒoƒo ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo gbɔ be woawɔ PDF ƒe dɔbiagbalẽvi siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu ɣesiaɣi, si nye kpɔɖeŋu nyui aɖe si dzi woato aɖe asidɔwɔwɔ dzi akpɔtɔ ahawɔ asitsatsa ŋuti nuŋlɔɖiwo woate ŋu agbugbɔe agblɔ.

rijandel_encryption.title: Rijandel ƒe Nya Ɣaɣla Dɔwɔɖoɖo
rijandel_encryption.text: 10+ Rijndael ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si wotsɔ sɔ kple wo nɔewo le 128-, 192-, kple 256-bit ƒe vovototowo me. Dzɔdzɔmeŋusẽŋununya si bua dedienɔnɔ ŋudɔwɔwɔ le gbegbɔgblɔwo katã me gbugbɔgawɔ nye dɔwɔwɔ si ŋu woɖɔ ɖo le nɔnɔme siwo sɔ pɛpɛpɛ, nuwɔna si woate ŋu ado kpɔ, kple seɖoƒe siwo le gbegbɔgblɔ ƒe ɖoɖo nu tsɔtsɔ yi teƒe bubuwo ŋu, . dzɔdzɔmeŋutete siwo katã ŋu viɖe le na ɖoɖo siwo kpɔa nyatakaka veviwo gbɔ.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft ƒe mɔnu
suprememc.text: Minecraft Mod si tsɔa dɔwɔnu siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu, aʋawɔnuwo, amehawo, blocks, dimensions, kple nu bubu geɖewo kpena ɖe fefea ŋu. Wotue kple Java ƒe tɔtrɔ 8-17 na Minecraft ƒe tɔtrɔ tiatia siwo le 1.16 kple 1.20 dome.

snake.title: Snake Game
snake.text: Wotu mɔ̃ si wotsɔ Rust kple Macroquad wɔ la ɖe WebAssoci, eye woɖe egɔme to HTML5 Canvas dzi. Ewɔa game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kpakple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd 0.12 kple game siwo ƒe didime nye sekɛnd suite si ƒo nu tso game ƒe se vevi aɖewo ŋu.

tiger_programming_language.title: Tiger ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi Gbegbɔgblɔ
tiger_programming_language.text: Dɔwɔɖoɖo ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ kple gbegɔmeɖela tɔxɛ si wotu ɖe Go me be nàdzro gbegbɔgblɔ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ, dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nuwɔna, kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe asitsatsa me. Eƒoƒo ƒu ɖe WebAssembly me kple etsɔtsɔ de portfolio la me wɔa adzɔnuwo ƒe anyigba ŋutɔŋutɔ, si woate ŋu alé ŋku ɖe eŋu na systems-level engineering tsɔ wu be woagblẽ dɔa ɖi abe a nudzraɖoƒe ɖeɖeko dodokpɔ.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tiger Tailgating Pros ƒe Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: React nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si wotsɔ yi na Clemson, SC tailgating dɔwɔƒe aɖe. Dɔa ɖea asitsaha sue aɖe ƒe nunana gɔme wòzua asisiwo ƒe mɔzɔzɔ si me kɔ kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe anyinɔnɔ si dzi woate ŋu aka ɖo, si zãa adzɔnuwo ŋuti susu tsɔ kpena ɖe habɔbɔ ŋutɔŋutɔ ŋu wòtrɔa ɖetsɔleme ɖe nyabiasewo kple gakpɔkpɔ me.

turing_machine.title: Turing Mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔƒe ƒe Dɔwɔna
turing_machine.text: Ƒome si wu 30+ ƒe dɔwɔwɔwo le Turing Mɔ̃a. Wozãnɛ tsɔ ɖea turing ƒe blibonyenye fiana na ɖoɖowɔɖi gbe vovovowo hena numekuku, vevietɔ na Tiger Programming Language.

contact.title: Te Ðe Ŋunye
contact.description: Meɖoa nyabiase siwo tso email kple LinkedIn gbedasiwo me ŋu. Magbugbɔ ka aƒo ka hã ne wotsɔ nye xexlẽdzesi na to dɔbiagbalẽvi dzi alo to mɔ bubu aɖe dzi, togbɔ be medi be nye telefon xexlẽdzesi nanɔ ɣaɣla hã.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Linter ƒe ƒuƒoƒo
formatter.description: Dɔwɔnu si wotu ɖe nyatakakawo ƒe nyonyome dzi si wotu ɖe web-browser dzi si ɖoa kpe JSON kple YAML dzi hewɔa ɖoɖo ɖe wo ŋu to Go mɔ̃ si woƒo ƒu ɖe WebAssembly me. Xɔtuɖaŋua yia edzi nɔa nu me tom le zãla la gbɔ tututu hena nyaŋuɖoɖo kabakaba, si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ esime wòle nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ ƒe se ŋutɔŋutɔwo dzi wɔm le nyatakakawo ƒe liƒo dzi. Enye kpɔɖeŋu si le sue si nye ɖoɖowɔwɔ ɖe developer ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɖoɖo si dzi woate ŋu aka ɖo ŋu ƒo xlã dzɔdzɔenyenye, dɔwɔwɔ, kple kakaɖedzi.

formatter.empty_input: Taflatse ŋlɔ JSON alo YAML aɖewo ɖe lint me.

formatter.fixed_yaml_spacing: ⚠ YAML ƒe dometsotso/nuŋɔŋlɔ si mesɔ o nɔ esi gake woɖɔe ɖo le eɖokui si eye wowɔe ɖe ɖoɖo nu.

tiger.title: Tiger Gbegbɔgblɔ
tiger.description: Tiger nye ɖoɖowɔɖi ƒe gbegbɔgblɔ si wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu kple Go gbegɔmeɖela si wotu be woatsɔ adzro dɔwɔwɔ ƒe xɔtuɖaŋu, gbegbɔgblɔ ƒe gɔmesese, kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe asitsatsa me. Gbegɔmeɖela la ƒoƒo ƒu ɖe WebAssembly me trɔa be ɖoɖowo nawɔ dɔ wòzua nusi wɔa dɔ, si wotu ɖe web-browser dzi: ezãlawo ate ŋu awɔ dɔwɔɖoɖowo tẽ esime dɔwɔwɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣia gakpɔtɔ nye esi woate ŋu atsɔ ayi teƒe bubu eye woɖee ɖe aga tso host dɔwɔɖoɖoa gbɔ.
